title: Report CLI parse errors instead of panicking
author: ChrisJr404
summary: Replaces unwrap() on parse/bundle/minify/print/browserslist results in src/main.rs with a report_error helper that prints the error and exits 1, plus two CLI integration tests. CLI-only, mechanical, mirrors the existing css-modules pattern error handling.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI: `.cls { asd }` panics: "thread 'main' panicked at src/main.rs:196:45: called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: Error { kind: EndOfInput ..."`. No other PR for #578. Library code untouched; only exit code changes (101 panic -> 1). May textually conflict with #1020 (adjacent lines in main.rs); merge one then rebase the other.
